sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Shipment_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Order_Items"."order_item_status" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Shipment_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Shipment_Items"."order_item_id"  GROUP BY "Shipment_Items"."order_item_id", "Order_Items"."order_item_status"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
